'''Resource Development''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Production Division]]. It was tasked with the development and construction of new facilities throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
